notes: out at t013 is read as the causative verb's phrasal particle, since bare brought does not write the hiphil of yatsa; min then keeps of. The alternative reads out of as one rendering of min under rule 24 and leaves brought alone to the verb.
provoked ... to anger heads on anger, since the Hebrew lexeme is the anger and provoked is the light verb (rule 44).
followed is one word for halak ahare, contiguous and owning no part separately, so the pair fuses under rule 30 headed on the verb.
